rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=120, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.05, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-4 REDO (breast ItNet v1, search-20260703-01). Prior iter-4 (unet_c 16->32, ep120) was CANCELLED DUE TO TIME LIMIT (c16/ep120 was already 1190s ~ the 1200s budget; 4x denoiser conv cost overran the 30-min wall). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR NUMBERS: iter-1 (k5,c16,ep20) hr 0.0000; iter-2 (k5,c16,ep120) hr 0.0000 ssim 0.7114; iter-3 (k1,c16,ep120) hr 0.8199 ssim 0.9815 PSNR 51.21 elapsed 1190s KEPT (best). (2) FAILURE MODE: budget overrun on the width lever; also note the DC step at k=1/alpha=0.1 may still slightly over-correct on 128-view sparse breast (each DC step FBPs a sparse-view residual = mild streak). (3) ONE KNOB (COMPUTE-FREE, guaranteed in-budget): itnet_alpha 0.1 -> 0.05. Same k=1, ep=120, c=16, train_n=400, val_n=200 as the KEPT iter-3 -> identical ~1190s train/score cost, no overrun risk. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I halve the single DC-step strength, I expect hr to edge above 0.8199 because the fixed (untrained) DC step re-injects a mild sparse-view streak that slightly corrupts the clean denoiser output; a gentler step preserves more denoiser quality. FALSIFIER: if hr is flat/lower, the k=1 DC step is already near-optimal or mildly helpful and alpha is not the lever -> the denoiser (width/data) is the true ceiling, to be probed in iter-5 with a BUDGET-SAFE capacity move (c=24 with epochs cut to fit). (5) BUDGET: byte-for-byte the iter-3 cost profile (only a float alpha changed) = ~1190s < 1200s, safely inside the 30-min wall. (6) Loop continues; iter-5 dispatched on landing. Artifacts: AGENT4CT_MODEL_CKPT set -> model_ckpt.pt persists.
